data.creator_notes:
This one's such an unabashed self-congratulatory mind-sink that I'm not even going to bother with a fancy teaser here, aside from warning you away if sexism and the like aren't your kink.

Short story? Extremely misogynistic world where you can run around doing whatever the fuck you want, from cuddling to killing (except, you know, the sorts of things the mods have made off limits. If the bot starts going that direction, let me know ASAP and I'll rework the code).

Men are extremely rare in this world, so you won't need to worry about competition unless you actively want that. To leave the bot open to whatever the user wants, any sort of guidance has been left to a minimum (Including a stupidly short intro message).
